source_snapshot.procedure_direct_xlsx: 【Before Test】 1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition. 2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.). 【During Test】 Hardware required: RDIMM with ECC / HDT Software tool: AMD RAS Error Injection Tool Test procedure: 1. BIOS settings: a. CPU Common Options → Platform First Error Handling: Enabled b. UMC Common Options → DDR PMIC Configuration → PMIC Error Reporting: True c. UMC Common Options → DDR PMIC Configuration → PMIC Operation Mode: Programmable Mode d. UMC Common Options → DDR PMIC Configuration → PMIC Fault Recovery: Always e. FCH Common Options → I3C/I2C Configuration Options → Release SPD Host Control: Disabled f. FCH Common Options → I3C/I2C Configuration Options → PMFW Poll DDR5 Telemetry: Disabled g. FCH Common Options → I3C/I2C Configuration Options → I3C/I2C 0 Enable: I2C Enabled h. FCH Common Options → I3C/I2C Configuration Options → I3C/I2C 1 Enable: I2C Enabled i. FCH Common Options → I3C/I2C Configuration Options → I3C/I2C 2 Enable: I2C Enabled j. FCH Common Options → I3C/I2C Configuration Options → I3C/I2C 3 Enable: I2C Enabled 2. Unlock CPU via HDT. 3. Boot into Ubuntu 20.04/RHEL 9.0 / Windows 2022. 4. Download the AMD RAS Error Injection Tool, then install and open the software. 5. Enter the following commands: sudo ./cmdline_amdraserrorinjectiontest --listvalidumc 6. Fatal error injection: sudo ./cmdline_amdraserrorinjectiontest --einjpmicerrors --socketdieumc 0:0:3 --railtype 0 --voltagetype 0 --dimm 0 6.1 The system will reset immediately. 6.2 When system boot into operating system again, check dmesg log. 7.Repeat step 1 to step 6 for all DIMMs with different voltagetype as 0/1. 【After Test】 1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders. 2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria_direct_xlsx: 1. For Uncorrectable errors, the tool provides a PASS status. 2. If the OS reports the error within a timeout period, the test passed. 3. If the OS does not report the error within a timeout period, the test failed. 4. Follow the AMD RAS Spec to check the dmesg and Error inject report.
source_snapshot.deepseek_direct_xlsx: PARTIAL | -- Fatal Error - SWA: inject the DDR PMIC Fatal Error - SWA via the AMD RAS Error Injection Tool (after HDT/unlock + the BIOS RAS knobs from the procedure, e.g. Platform First Error Handling=Enabled + per-unit MCA/UMC settings). Agent stages/verifies with sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "dmesg -T 2>&1 | tail -160 | grep -iE 'PMIC|power.good|critical|over.current|over.voltage|switchover|temperature|current.limit'; echo __DDR_PMIC_Fatal_Error_-_SWA; ipmitool sel elist 2>&1 | tail -40 2>&1" but the tool injection step itself is interactive/HW-level and needs the user to drive the exact inject command.

test_case.test_name: Fatal Error - SWA — retained controlled review-layer procedure
test_case.purpose: Inject a fatal SWA rail error for every required DDR5 PMIC/DIMM and voltage type, verify the intended immediate reset and fresh SWA-specific persistent evidence, then prove voltage, temperature, memory and I2C management recovery before the next target.
required_package: Populated DIMM-to-socket/die/UMC/channel/slot/PMIC-address map and complete per-run tuple matrix
Wistron BMC/platform I2C controller/bus/address/OOB path and expected response for each PMIC
Vendor proof railtype0 is SWA and definitions/expected signatures for voltagetype0 and 1
Correct command-line continuation plus approved socketdieumc/dimm value for every target
PMIC rail voltage/current/temperature safe envelope, hard aborts and fatal/reset behavior
Fresh PMIC/CPER/BERT/SEL fields, reset/boot deadlines, memory-training/workload recovery and full restoration
test_case.test_command: Map every DIMM to socket/die/UMC/channel/slot, PMIC address and BMC/platform I2C controller/bus; prove railtype0=SWA and voltagetype0/1 meanings; approve a syntactically valid tuple per run; capture electrical/log baseline; inject one target under OOB capture; decode fresh PMIC/CPER/SEL evidence; validate reset/boot, rail telemetry, memory training and workload; restore settings and re-enable telemetry before any next run.
